subtitle: An 18-kilometer beach by Turkish Wikipedia's measure (MEDASSET's own reports give 12 km) and buried Lycian capital that Turkey placed under a construction ban in 1990 to save nesting loggerhead turtles — a ban conservationists say hundreds of buildings have gone up inside anyway.
spike_statement: A 1990 law banned construction on Patara's beach to save turtles and buried ruins; MEDASSET counted 255 buildings under construction inside the zone anyway.

levers.photo_tone: Flat gold dune-sand under hard Mediterranean sun, turquoise shallows, and half-buried Roman stone breaking through grass-stitched dunes.
